name: What kind of maintenance does a water pressure regulator require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does a water pressure regulator require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water pressure regulators generally require minimal maintenance, but they should be checked periodically to ensure they are functioning correctly. We recommend having your water pressure checked annually, especially if you notice changes in water flow or pressure. Over time, sediment can build up, or internal components may wear, affecting its performance. Our team can inspect and adjust your regulator during a routine plumbing check-up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regulators need minimal maintenance but should be checked annually for proper function and wear, especially if water pressure changes.
